name: IFS Fern Color
summary: This EA renders a Barnsley Fern fractal using the Iterated Function System (IFS) algorithm onto a BMP image displayed on the MetaTrader 5 chart. It uses a virtual screen with a color palette to produce a heatmap-style visualization where pixel color intensity reflects how many times each point was visited. Clicking the fern image zooms in by increasing the scale coefficient by 10% each time.
summary_zh: 该EA使用迭代函数系统(IFS)算法在MetaTrader 5图表上渲染巴恩斯利蕨类植物分形图案。它使用带有调色板的虚拟屏幕来生成热图式可视化效果，像素颜色强度反映每个点被访问的次数。点击蕨类图像可以通过每次增加10%的缩放系数来放大。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易EA，而是一个基于迭代函数系统(IFS)的数学可视化工具。它通过Barnsley蕨类植物的4个仿射变换系数来生成分形图案，每个变换有不同的概率权重（1%、85%、7%、7%）。算法从原点开始迭代，每次根据累积概率随机选择一个仿射变换来计算新坐标，经过约10万次以上的迭代后将点绘制到800x800的虚拟屏幕上。虚拟屏幕上的每个像素记录被访问的次数，然后通过23色调色板映射为RGB颜色，形成热图效果。用户可以通过点击图表上的蕨类图像来交互式缩放，每次点击缩放系数增加10%。该EA没有任何交易逻辑、仓位管理或风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading EA but a mathematical visualization tool based on the Iterated Function System (IFS). It generates a fractal pattern using the 4 affine transformation coefficients of the Barnsley Fern, each with different probability weights (1%, 85%, 7%, 7%). The algorithm starts from the origin and iterates, randomly selecting an affine transformation based on cumulative probabilities to compute new coordinates, drawing points onto an 800x800 virtual screen after over 100,000 iterations. Each pixel on the virtual screen records its visit count, which is then mapped to RGB colors through a 23-color palette to produce a heatmap effect. Users can interactively zoom by clicking the fern image on the chart, with each click increasing the scale coefficient by 10%. This EA has no trading logic, position management, or risk control whatsoever.

parameters.description_en: Scaling factor controlling fractal display ratio

parameters.name: back (Render)
parameters.description: 是否将图像显示为背景对象

pros: 使用迭代函数系统算法精确渲染Barnsley蕨类分形，数学上严谨
实现了基于访问次数的热图调色板，视觉效果丰富
支持交互式缩放，用户点击即可放大查看分形细节
代码结构清晰，使用面向对象的CIFS类封装IFS逻辑
pros_en: Accurately renders the Barnsley Fern fractal using the mathematically rigorous IFS algorithm
Implements a heatmap palette based on visit counts for rich visual output
Supports interactive zoom - users can click to enlarge and see fractal detail
Clean code structure with the CIFS class encapsulating IFS logic using OOP
cons: 不是交易程序，没有交易信号或策略逻辑
随机数生成器使用rand()/32767.0，精度较低且分布不均匀
迭代次数随缩放系数动态增长，大缩放时可能导致性能问题
没有提供重置缩放的功能，点击只能放大不能缩小
cons_en: Not a trading program - contains no trading signals or strategy logic
Random number generator uses rand()/32767.0 which has low precision and non-uniform distribution
Iteration count grows dynamically with scale, potentially causing performance issues at large zoom
No way to reset zoom - clicking only zooms in, never zooms out
improvements: 使用MathRand()或更好的随机数生成方法替代rand()/32767.0以提高概率分布质量
添加缩放重置功能（例如双击重置或右键菜单），增强交互体验
improvements_en: Replace rand()/32767.0 with MathRand() or a better RNG method for improved probability distribution quality
Add zoom reset functionality (e.g., double-click to reset or context menu) for better interactivity

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
大缩放系数下高迭代次数可能导致终端卡顿
risk_points_en: This EA performs no trading operations, so there is no financial risk
High iteration counts at large zoom levels may cause terminal slowdown
